Messages.Body:
Doyle Fincher
Clan: Gangrel antitribu (group 4)
Capacity: 7
Disciplines: ANI PRO aus for obf
Sabbat: During your discard phase, if any of your prey's ready vampires
are not at full capacity, move 1 blood from the blood bank to one of
those vampires and 1 blood from the blood bank to Doyle. +1 bleed.

If I have Doyle Fincher is in play and my prey has no ready vampires,
does he get a blood?

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

Messages.Author: Bram Vink
Messages.Body:
XZealot schreef:



If there are no "prey's ready vampires" the condition of them being not
at full capacity cannot be fulfilled.

B

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct.

The question investigated by card text is: "are any of your prey's ready
vampires not at full capacity?"

The answer from the game state you describe is: "no".
